title: Reef Futures 2026

sources: Concurrent oral sessions, RF26 PDF linked from that page.
Workshops, reeffutures.com/workshops-2026. Public list had no per-seat sold-out flag.
notes: Hotel breakfast each morning. Hour not on the grid.
Sunday opening reception. Evening. Hour not on the grid.
Wednesday Reefs to Reels film festival. Evening. Hour not on the grid.
Friday closing reception. Evening. Hour not on the grid.
Karaoke party is included in registration. Hour not published.
Field trips are a separate signup. No public schedule.
Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday afternoons put talks and workshops on the same hours.
